jobs.description:
Main Responsibilities

The Technical Sales Manager contributes annually to the development of a strategic sales plan, in consultation with management (including objectives, KPIs, segmentation, and action points). In addition, weekly consultations and monthly reporting will be required.

Building and expanding a proactive and sustainable network of customers, prospects, partners (suppliers, machine builders, ...)

In most projects, the Technical Sales Manager will act as coordinator between customers, engineering offices, partners, suppliers, and the Revimaxx team.

You continuously monitor the market and trends and also share these internally. You pay attention to developments in technologies, relationships between customers/partners, subcontracting, opportunities, ...

You are open to and contribute to active marketing support, social media communication, participation in trade fairs, training sessions, ...

In this role, a combination of technical/mechanical expertise and a sense for economic reality is necessary. This may have been built through experience, interest, education... or perhaps through a combination of these.

• Industrial Engineer, Civil Engineer, or equivalent through experience
• Initial technical sales and/or consultancy experience (with technical expertise) and demonstrable results are a must, with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
• You have a strong affinity with the machine construction sector and are passionate about the mechanical possibilities of small and large machines/systems.
• Your commercial experience motivates you to independently evaluate opportunities and pursue them.
• You are conceptually strong and enjoy thinking together with the customer in a co-creative way to arrive at the best solution for their challenge.
• You are analytical and skilled with numbers in order to quickly determine margins and feasibility of projects. You have a sense for the economic reality of each project.
• You possess strong communication skills and communicate effectively with customers, partners, and the Revimaxx team. (knowledge of perfect English, and willingness to learn Dutch quickly)
• You have a natural ambition to grow and to support the growth of Revimaxx.
• You are results-oriented, loyal, flexible, and demonstrate strong perseverance.
• You hold a valid for wheel driving licence.

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?
Would you like to join an international working environment?
Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Looking for an international environment? Do you possess strong B2B communication skills? Then this technical support role within the medical device sector is looking for you! Here in Machelen, you will be handling incoming communication from internal and external stakeholders and be responsible for:

• Following strict internal guidelines to ensure a high level of reporting quality for medical matters.
• Processing and updating projects in SAP.
• Monitoring POs and shipments.
• Escalating more complex problems to the specific departments, which could be regarding accounting or more technical issues. It depends on the problem!
• Logging and archiving of reports and contracts.
• Backup for other administrative tasks.
 

• You communicate fluently in English AND Italian or Spanish.
• In possession of a university degree and a Belgian working permit
• Experience within larger company structures is a plus.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise applications across back-end and front-end technologies. Architect scalable solutions, apply advanced software design patterns, and mentor junior and medior developers. Utilize the Microsoft ecosystem, modern front-end frameworks, Azure cloud services, messaging platforms, and architectural practices like CQRS, DDD, and Clean Architecture to deliver robust and business-aligned solutions.
Key responsibilities

• Architect and design scalable enterprise applications

• Implement and enforce advanced software patterns (CQRS, DDD, Clean Architecture)

• Design, implement, and maintain MicroServices-based architectures

• Develop clean, secure, and maintainable code across front-end and back-end

• Mentor and coach junior and medior developers, perform code reviews

• Build interactive user interfaces with modern front-end frameworks (Angular, Blazor, React)

• Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate requirements into technical solutions

• Implement and optimize containerized solutions with Kubernetes, Docker, or AKS

• Design and integrate distributed systems using messaging Middleware (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka)

• Leverage Azure services for cloud-native, scalable, and secure solutions

• Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps best practices

Very good knowledge in the following technologies is a plus

• C#

• .NET Core

• ASP.NET Core

• Entity Framework Core

• LINQ

• RESTful API design and integration

• SQL Server

• MicroServices architecture

• CQRS

• DDD

• Clean Architecture principles

• Blazor or Angular

• TypeScript

• JavaScript

• Unit & integration testing

• CI/CD pipelines

• Microsoft Azure

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• AKS

• WPF (XAML) is a plus

• Problem-solving

• Rigorous methodology

Qualifications

• 5+ years in .NET / .NET Core development

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus

• English + French and / or Dutch

Searching for a job in Sales? Eager to learn everything from the bottom to the top?
Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a highly self-motivated, results oriented and solutions driven Management Trainee with a general interest in all levels of a business and a general interest in developing new technologies. After completing the management trainee program, you will be assigned to a full-time position in Sales.

The client's management trainee program is designed for recent university graduates who are highly motivated and have the potential to excel as future global leaders at the company. The training program is customized to meet the skills of the employee along with the needs of the company.

It offers challenging work assignments along with hands on training in manufacturing, quality control, administration, sales & marketing, and logistics. You will be exposed to all areas of the business and learn by successfully completing various projects in the different departments.

• A master or bachelor degree.
• If you have already strong sales skills for new account development that would be an advantage.
• 2 years of previous work experiences.
• A fluent pen and verbal skills in English and Dutch. Any additional languages would be great.
• Able to work autonomously, in a structured and efficient way.
• Strong sense of urgency, listening, communication and organizational skills.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

• Coordinate and oversee all aspects of maritime transportation operations, including vessel scheduling, cargo handling, and port logistics. 
• Liaise with shipping carriers, freight forwarders, and customs authorities to ensure timely and cost-effective cargo movement. 
• Maintain accurate records of cargo shipments, documentation, and tracking information. 
• Maintain strong relationships with existing clients while proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities. 
• Resolve any shipping-related issues or discrepancies in a timely manner. 
• Accomany the GM on client visits as required by business needs (infrequent)
 
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is preferred. 
• Over 3 years proven experience in shipping operations or maritime logistics. 
• Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures. 
• Strong computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office and shipping software. 
• Excellent communication skills.Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is a plus. 
• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities. 
• Ability to work effectively under pressure . 
• Team player with a proactive and positive attitude.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent). You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48) or late shift (14u00 - 22u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 or 13u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

For an international and multicultural organisation based in Brussels, we are looking for an Administrative & Events Assistant to join their team.

In this role, you will be responsible for a variety of administrative and organisational tasks, while also supporting the organisation of events and activities.

 

Your responsibilities as Administrative and Events Assistant :

• Managing the general mailbox and forwarding requests to the relevant person
• Managing and organising documents through SharePoint, Teams and physical archives
• Providing administrative support to the team and ongoing projects
• Maintaining the annual calendar and keeping track of activities
• Supporting the preparation of subsidy applications
• Following up on memberships, sponsors and partners in collaboration with the accounting team
• Supporting the organisation of events: contacting venues, caterers and suppliers, requesting quotations and coordinating practical details
• Preparing meetings and ensuring everything is organised and running smoothly

Your profile as Administrative and Events Assistant : 

• Has a first experience in administration, or is a recent graduate looking to develop their experience
• Is organised, proactive and hands-on
• Is able to work independently and take initiative
• Has good common sense and a strong sense of responsibility
• Is discreet and understands the importance of confidentiality
• Enjoys organising events and making sure everything is taken care of
• Is comfortable working in a multicultural environment
• Has a very good command of English; French and Dutch are a strong asset
• Has a driving licence

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

You start your day with a full truck and drive to supermarkets and distribution points. Every trip brings new places and regular customers. 
You work according to a fixed daily schedule.
You are the company's calling card.

Our client is a reliable player in frozen food logistics. They combine a modern fleet with a professional approach and attach great importance to safety and punctuality.

- You deliver frozen goods to supermarkets and distribution centers
- You deliver to multiple locations per day and ensure correct unloading
- You manage delivery documents accurately
- You communicate smoothly with planners and customers when necessary
- You respect driving and rest times and always drive safely
- Vaardigheden:
You have experience as a CE driver.
You are flexible and enjoy starting your day early.
You drive responsibly and think about safety.

Our client is a leading international organization specializing in technology lifecycle management and financing solutions, supporting businesses across a wide range of industries. With a strong global presence and a collaborative culture, they offer innovative services that help companies optimize the use, management, and renewal of their technology assets.

Jobomschrijving

 As a Global Operations Specialist, you will ensure the efficient administration of leasing contracts throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include;

• Processing orders and purchases
• Managing leasing schedules and invoices
• Maintaining customer and supplier data
• Coordinating deliveries and returns
• Handling documentation
• Providing operational support to customers while driving process improvements.

 The ideal candidate is fluent in Dutch, French, and English and possesses strong administrative and organizational skills. You have excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, are comfortable working with complex systems, and bring experience from an international environment. You are proactive, detail-oriented, able to prioritize effectively, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively to deliver high-quality results.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You are ready to work in the fixed afternoon shift.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse operator | Zaventem | ENG + NL or FR
jobs.description:
We are looking for a warehouse operator for a company in Zaventem. 

You will be responsible for the daily warehouse operations and help your team to ensure processes run efficiently and safely.

Your responsibilities:

 

 
• You coordinate inbound (receiving, storage, inventory) and outbound (picking, packing, shipping) activities 
 
• You check incoming goods (including cold chain) and monitor stock levels 
 
• You work with WMS and report on performance 
 
• You plan transport and oversee order processing 
 
• You ensure safety, quality (SOPs), and warehouse organization 
 
• You improve processes and solve operational issues 

 
• You have a first experience working in a warehouse 
 
• You have experience with WMS, inventory management, and order processing 
 
• Knowledge of pharma/logistics SOPs is a plus 
 
• You have strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills 
 
• You are hands-on, accurate, and able to perform under pressure 
 
• You have a very good knowledge of English. In addition, you also have a very good knowledge of Dutch or French

jobs.occupation: Comptable AP Team leader English and French
jobs.description:
Our client is an international company located in Liege.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Team Leader Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Supervise and manage the accounts payable team to ensure smooth operations.
• Mentoring and training Junior Accountants to support their professional development and strengthen their technical accounting skills.
• Oversee invoice processing and payment approvals in compliance with company policies.
• Coordinate with internal departments and external vendors to resolve payment discrepancies.
• Maintain accurate records of all accounts payable transactions.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal controls.
• Prepare and review reports related to accounts payable performance.
• Support month-end and year-end closing processes as required.
• Propose process improvements to enhance efficiency in the accounts payable function.

A successful AP Team Leader Accountant should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Experience in accounts payable or similar financial operations roles.
• Strong organisational and team management skills.
• Proficiency in Excel.
• Knowledge of French and English.
• Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
• Good communication skills for liaising with vendors and internal teams.
• Problem-solving abilities to address payment or process issues effectively.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Residence in Liege.
